I don't have reliable, current information on LlamaIndex's Python 3.9 status, so I can't give you a definitive answer. I also can't see your repository from here.

What I can say from general knowledge:

- Python 3.9 reached end-of-life in October 2025, and many Python libraries have dropped support for it since then.
- LlamaIndex dropped Python 3.8 support in its 0.1x releases, so 3.9 may have been dropped in later releases too, but I don't know the exact version or date.
- LlamaIndex is split into many packages (`llama-index-core` and numerous integration packages), and they may not all have made the change at the same time.

To check the current status, look at the `requires-python` field in each package's `pyproject.toml`, or run `pip show llama-index-core` and check the "Requires-Python" metadata. The GitHub releases and changelog for each package will show when support was removed. If you tell me which packages you're using, I can help you interpret those results.
